Hacking a computer requires knowledge and access to the system. It is possible to gain access to a computer through phishing emails, malware, or by physically gaining access to the machine. Once access is gained, the attacker can try to exploit known software vulnerabilities or use tools and methods such as brute force and dictionary attacks to gain access to the system. Additionally, attackers may look for ways to gain administrative privileges or try to gain access to weak passwords.
